text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: prom-scrape-exporter-504s (severity: high)
incident-bot: target: metrics-ingest-prod, symptoms: repeated 504 from prometheus exporter (10m), log-forwarder backlog increasing ~300k msgs
pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident opened (INC12345) — paging @oncall 
alex: Acked — oncall here, looking. seeing lots of 504s from exporter-03 in eu-west-1. clustering probes show ~30% scrape failures.
taylor: Confirmed. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/metrics -> exporter-03 error spike at 12:03 UTC. Also kafka consumer lag up to 250k.
alex: Can someone grab logs from exporter-03? try: ```kubectl logs -n infra exporter-03 --since=15m``` 
morgan: grabbing logs now, tail shows repeated "upstream timeout" and these lines: 
```
2026-02-11T12:03:05Z ERROR http: GET /metrics -> upstream timeout after 10s
2026-02-11T12:04:10Z WARN exporter: scrape_retry=3 backoff=2s
2026-02-11T12:04:38Z ERROR http: GET /metrics -> connection reset by peer
```
morgan: exporter restarted twice in last 2hrs. Memory looks fine. fd count high (~14k).
sam: kafka-consumer pods are getting OOM-slice? I see throttling on disk i/o on node euw-12. Scaling consumers by +3 as temporary.
alex: Good. I'm going to cordon exporter-03 and rotate it out of pool, then scale replicas for exporter deployment to 5. Doing rollout: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus-exporters -n infra``` 
jen: Heads up, I'll take the handoff in 20m once you have mitigations and we've confirmed backlog is decreasing.
taylor: Also enabling quick-prefix caching on the serving tier to reduce scrape pressure: toggling `metrics_cache_enabled=true` for 10m window (feature-flag).
morgan: After restart, exporter-03 logs show it rejoined and served metrics, but still some 502s to /stats endpoint from the sidecar. Investigating sidecar network hiccups.
sam: Consumer scaling started — lag falling from 250k -> 70k in ~8m.
alex: Nice. I'm going to drain exporter-03 from the LB and redeploy sidecar: ```kubectl delete pod exporter-03-sidecar -n infra && kubectl rollout restart deploy/exporter-sidecar -n infra``` 
incident-bot: Note: automated backfill job queued to catch up ~300k messages once consumers healthy. Estimated completion ~30-40m.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 escalated to SRE Manager (automatic, 15m unack from next tier) — manual ack exists.
taylor: customer-impact check: metrics for a small number of customers were missing for ~12 minutes — no writes lost (buffered), but dashboards read 504. Customer support notified to triage top-10 accounts.
jen: Thanks. I'm about to run a health check script and confirm no more 5xx. Script: ```/opt/sre/bin/metrics-healthcheck --targets=exporters --threshold=1%``` 
morgan: healthcheck output: exporters failed rate 0.8% over last 5m, kafka lag trending down, backfill job queued.
alex: OK looks good. I'm going to mark the immediate remediation as done: rotated exporter, scaled consumers, requeued backfill. Leaving monitoring on for 1h.
sam: adding a temporary alert suppression for noisy exporter restarts to avoid page storms: Incidentbot suppression rule ID: sup-2026-02-scrape-temp
taylor: Action items: 1) postmortem (assigned alex), 2) runbook update to include sidecar fd limits and supervisor policy (assigned morgan), 3) capacity tweak for consumers (assigned sam).
jen: I'll take next oncall handoff and watch for regressions. Please add any customer notes to the incident in PD.
alex: Filing quick summary in INC12345 and creating slack summary channel #inc-12345-summary.
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by alex, no further auto-escalation.
jen: Closing for now, keeping on-call watch for 60m. If anything flares, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
